headline: Shared 3D model shelf ships to prod
lede: One CC0 shelf every arcade game can now browse and reuse: rigged characters, the dune buggy, and a hand-built low-poly scenery kit — indexed, gated, and live.

notes.text: public/models/shelf.json is the single index (name, pack, license, size, bounds per model); loadModel(id) in src/utils/modelShelf.js hands games a ready scene. SSX and Comet Drift HD already repointed at it.

13 original CC0 scenery props authored procedurally in the KayKit voxel idiom (trees, rocks, fence, grandstand, marshal post, pit building, billboard…). itch.io pack downloads are outside the GitHub/npm-only network rule, so the kit is Forge-made and provenance-honest.

shelfcheck gates schema, CC0-only licenses, structural glTF validity and the model ids #638/#639 depend on — 94 assertions, mutant-proven red. First forge infra PR off the shelf unblocks both mountain and trackside lanes.
